about_the_game:
Baseball: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade is a single screen 2D arcade game where you have to catch baseballs. You can move left and right to try and catch the baseballs, which increases your score. If you miss one, it's game over! How high of a score can you get?

This game was released on Sunday, September 29th, 2024 as part of week 184 of Bible Video Game Sundays. Bible Video Game Sundays is an event by Breakthrough Gaming where a new video game releases every Sunday Morning @ 6:00 AM Eastern Time*! (*release dates and times subject to change)

About the Breakthrough Gaming Arcade series
In the Breakthrough Gaming Arcade series, play arcade games that express a Biblical truth, complete with retro graphics and sounds!

This game is based on 1st Thessalonians Chapter 5 in the Bible.

Baseball: Breakthrough Gaming Arcade © 2007-2024 Myron Kevan Tynes Jr. / Breakthrough Gaming LLC. All Rights Reserved.
